short_horizon_simulator.reason: the preregistered full-state 1e-4 repeat tolerance is satisfied by pinned PhysX CPU; a pre-formal-result interface smoke found PhysX CUDA full-state drift while task outcomes remained stable

primary_predicates.near_completion: official success occurs at the current state or within the next four recorded actions
primary_predicates.contact_insertion_or_placement: intended contact is active at the current state and near_completion is false
primary_predicates.pre_contact_or_pre_grasp: intended contact is inactive now and becomes active within the next four recorded actions, with near_completion false
primary_predicates.free_space: intended contact is inactive now and for the next four recorded actions, no success occurs within four actions, and timestep/trajectory_length <= 0.50

fixed_temporal_fallback.purpose: populate a named task phase only when fewer than 16 unique-trajectory primary candidates survive restoration

restoration.actions: the same next four recorded source actions
